name: shiftrelay
description: ShiftRelay local demo: memory-only private shift notes become reviewed shared tasks with server-confirmed ownership, resolution and reopening. Firebase emulators only; no cloud deployment.

scripts.test:rules: py -3 scripts/firebase_safe.py emulators:exec --project demo-shiftrelay --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:e2e: py -3 scripts/firebase_safe.py emulators:exec --project demo-shiftrelay --only auth,firestore "playwright test"
scripts.test:tools: py -3 -m unittest tests.test_check_diagrams tests.test_verificar tests.test_scan_secrets tests.test_firebase_safe tests.test_dev_live_local tests.test_dist_guard tests.test_release_prep -v
